purpose: Test a frozen summer model on later, unseen seasonal windows; no fitting, selection or calibration
quality: Approved, unqualified, finite values; nonnegative oxygen; pinned series/statistic/units; preserve signed flow and authentic irregular timestamps
alignment: Twelve consecutive 30-minute UTC timestamps across all sources; exact oxygen target; skip missing joins; no interpolation
extrapolationCheck: Any selected feature outside its min/max on the original training phase; diagnostic only
operationalDecision: Observation-only regardless of outcome; a pass cannot authorize spending or promote the model
fallbackIfDataUnavailable: Report blocked or partial window; do not choose a different period after inspecting outcomes
disclosure: Finalized archival measurements; not independent field measurement or historical as-of-origin availability
